def col_to_num(col_letters):
    n = 0
    for ch in col_letters.upper():
        n = n * 26 + (ord(ch) - ord("A") + 1)
    return n

def split_top_level(text, delimiter):
    parts = []
    current = []
    in_quotes = False
    depth = 0
    i = 0
    while i < len(text):
        ch = text[i]
        if ch == '"':
            current.append(ch)
            if i + 1 < len(text) and text[i + 1] == '"':
                current.append(text[i + 1])
                i += 1
            else:
                in_quotes = not in_quotes
        elif not in_quotes and ch == "(":
            depth += 1
            current.append(ch)
        elif not in_quotes and ch == ")":
            depth -= 1
            current.append(ch)
        elif not in_quotes and depth == 0 and ch == delimiter:
            parts.append("".join(current).strip())
            current = []
        else:
            current.append(ch)
        i += 1
    parts.append("".join(current).strip())
    return parts

def excel_text(value):
    if value is None:
        return ""
    if isinstance(value, float) and value.is_integer():
        return str(int(value))
    return str(value)

def get_cell_reference_value(expr, current_ws):
    expr = expr.strip()
    m = re.fullmatch(r"(?:'([^']+)'|([A-Za-z0-9_ ]+))?!?\$?([A-Za-z]{1,3})\$?(\d+)", expr)
    if not m:
        return None, False

    sheet_name = m.group(1) or m.group(2)
    col = m.group(3)
    row = int(m.group(4))
    target_ws = wb[sheet_name] if sheet_name else current_ws
    value = target_ws.cell(row=row, column=col_to_num(col)).value
    return evaluate_value(value, target_ws), True

def evaluate_expr(expr, current_ws):
    expr = expr.strip()
    if expr.startswith("="):
        expr = expr[1:].strip()

    # Quoted string literal
    if len(expr) >= 2 and expr[0] == '"' and expr[-1] == '"':
        return expr[1:-1].replace('""', '"')

    # Numeric literal
    if re.fullmatch(r"-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?", expr):
        number = float(expr)
        return int(number) if number.is_integer() else number

    # IF(logical_test, value_if_true, value_if_false)
    if expr.upper().startswith("IF(") and expr.endswith(")"):
        args = split_top_level(expr[3:-1], ",")
        if len(args) >= 3:
            logical_test = args[0].strip()
            # Handle equality tests, e.g. Sheet1!F2=""
            test_parts = split_top_level(logical_test, "=")
            if len(test_parts) == 2:
                left = evaluate_expr(test_parts[0], current_ws)
                right = evaluate_expr(test_parts[1], current_ws)
                return evaluate_expr(args[1], current_ws) if excel_text(left) == excel_text(right) else evaluate_expr(args[2], current_ws)

    # Concatenation with &
    concat_parts = split_top_level(expr, "&")
    if len(concat_parts) > 1:
        return "".join(excel_text(evaluate_expr(part, current_ws)) for part in concat_parts)

    # Cell reference, optionally sheet-qualified
    ref_value, is_ref = get_cell_reference_value(expr, current_ws)
    if is_ref:
        return ref_value

    # Fallback: return expression text
    return expr

def evaluate_value(value, current_ws):
    if isinstance(value, str) and value.startswith("="):
        return evaluate_expr(value[1:], current_ws)
    return value

    end = len(parts)

    # Remove the final ID/code part after the last " - "
    if end - start >= 2:
        end -= 1

    return " - ".join(parts[start:end])
